name: Bukiyou na Binetsu
source:
Yasushi Nakagawa(Yattchi) is a high school student who is devoted to a part-time job more than necessary because of loss that first love did not fulfill.
Yattchi values the position of the leader left from his first love.However, Taiki Murakami, the newcomer's Freeter, takes the position of the leader from Yattchi.
Yattchi hated Murakami who was quiet and unfriendly and don't know what to think.
Yattchi touched the kindness of clumsy Murakami is gradually attracted to him.

[From [url=https://mosuke.booth.pm/items/1047884]BOOTH[/url]]
translation:
中川康（Yattchi饰）是一名高中生，由于初恋未能实现，他过度致力于打工。
Yattchi非常看重初恋留下的队长位置。然而，新人弗里特村上大树 (Taiki Murakami) 从Yattchi手中接过了队长的位置。
雅奇讨厌村上，因为他沉默寡言、不友善、不知道在想什么。
雅奇感动了笨手笨脚的村上，逐渐被他吸引。

[来自[url=https://mosuke.booth.pm/items/1047884]BOOTH[/url]]
